drivingQuestion: What 'locking the door' is there in barring her from a house of mourning?
outcomeNote: unit breaks mid-question; continued in ketubot.sugya306

segments.he: הַמַּדִּיר אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ וְכוּ׳. בִּשְׁלָמָא לְבֵית הַמִּשְׁתֶּה
segments.en: § The mishna states: «One who vows» and obligates «his wife» not to go to a house of mourning or to a house of feasting for a wedding, must divorce her and give her the payment of her marriage contract, because it is as if he were locking a door in front of her. The Gemara asks: «Granted,» when he forbids her from going «to a house of feasting,»
